description: Line patches against tree3 baseline; each [start,end,replacement_lines] uses zero-based half-open indices. Apply in reverse order.

records.name: double_layer
line_patch:
static inline void Frame_Memory_Line(StringClass &text, int i, unsigned memory) { StringClass line; line.Format("%s : %2.2fMb\n", WWMemoryLogClass::Get_Category_Name(i), (float)memory / (1024.0f * 1024.0f)); text += line; } static inline void Frame_Display_Memory_Line(StringClass &text, int i, unsigned memory) { Frame_Memory_Line(text, i, memory); }
				Frame_Display_Memory_Line(text, i, memory);

line_patch:
static inline void Frame_Memory_Line(StringClass &text, int i, unsigned memory) { StringClass line; StringClass &detail = line; detail.Format("%s : %2.2fMb\n", WWMemoryLogClass::Get_Category_Name(i), (float)memory / (1024.0f * 1024.0f)); text += detail; }
				Frame_Memory_Line(text, i, memory);
